releaseNotes:
v0.9.97

Status bar
- Toggle SESSION and LIFETIME. Session is the default each launch.
- Lifetime tracks time online, greets, and how many times Companion was started.

Triggers
- !stats is a default Info trigger again ({session_stats}).
- !lifetime replies with lifetime totals ({lifetime_stats}).
- List shows 6 rows with pagination only. Hover wraps the response; trigger, category, and buttons stay put.
- Edit a trigger: Add Trigger plus Update. Growing editors with a clear [x].
- Allow Multiple Replies is required for the same trigger with different replies.
- Categories with the same name in English and Russian are separate.
- Duplicate-trigger warning: CLOSE or Edit Category, then back to the trigger form.
- Switching language always shows All Categories.

Message Recorder
- On/off is saved. Own whispers are not recorded. Operator identity is kept when you leave the room.
- Answering Settings wraps on hover, does not side-scroll, and uses a growing input with [x].

Room Console
- Remembers Public / Whisper / DM. Whisper can prefix the user name. Direct DM send stays disabled.
- [R] asks before removing someone.
- Activity log: [Sent P.DM] and [Sent W.DM].

Greetings and roster
- After someone leaves, a stale present/join does not put them back.
- Welcome whispers need a real user id from the room list.
- Greeting, 2nd Msg, Console, and Recorder reply editors have a clear [x].

UI
- Row edit, delete, and reply buttons are 22×22 squares with a 2px gap.
